本研究面向多维表格评审：根据用户需求、待评设计和业务规则，识别具体问题并给出依据: This study addresses table-system review: identifying specific issues and evidence from user requirements, a proposed design, and business rules. From July to October 2026, the project aligned historical data and revised rules, then compared SFT, RL, OPD, and CoT to test whether specialized models can review accurately and completely.
多次元テーブルの審査を対象とし、ユーザー要求、設計、業務規則から具体的問題と根拠を特定する。2026年7〜10月に過去データを整え規則を改訂し、SFT・RL・OPD・CoTを比較して専用モデルの正確性と網羅性を検証した。
后期统一数据包含7,127个训练单元、792个测试单元，按原始需求隔离。三个SF: The later unified dataset has 7,127 training and 792 test units, split by original query. Three SFT models scored 55.72%–56.97% error-type F1 against Sol references, with misses the main weakness. Three of four later multi-issue RL runs improved; one rose 56.97%→58.91% on the 792 tests. In OPD, with label hints provided to both teachers, full student rules beat compact rules by 16.09 percentage points. Across three CoT targets sharing inputs and verdicts, verdict-only training beat explicit rationales under both references.

这些实验支持继续使用完整规则、兼顾正常设计及多问题的数据，并保留仅裁决训练作为理: The results favor full rules, data covering valid and multi-issue designs, and verdict-only training as the rationale baseline. Locating every instance of repeated issue types and grounding evidence in the correct object still need validation. The report also covers built-artifact review, which completed one evaluation with many false positives, and the DSH label pipeline, whose framework and partial trial are implemented. ATMS support sets and causal-pair synthesis remain proposals.

多维表格的设计涉及表结构、视图、仪表盘、工作流和权限。一份设计即使覆盖了这些模块: Table-system designs span schemas, views, dashboards, workflows, and permissions. Covering these modules does not ensure requirements are met. “Notify the owner when an order is overdue” needs a due date, overdue condition, recipient, and trigger working together. Missing any part breaks the requirement. Review must identify concrete gaps so later repairs have evidence.
設計は表構造、ビュー、ダッシュボード、処理、権限に及ぶ。モジュールを全て書いても要求達成とは限らない。「注文遅延時に担当者へ通知」には期限、遅延判定、受信者、起動処理の連携が必要で、一つ欠ければ機能しない。審査は後の修正に根拠を与える具体的欠落を示す必要がある。
项目把业务知识整理成逐条评审规则，称为rubric。每条规则说明适用条件、违规情: Business knowledge is organized into rubrics, each specifying applicability, violations, exceptions, and named errors. Two difficulties remain: models can misread scope and flag valid designs, or stop after one issue and miss other objects. Historical labels also come from different design versions and review rounds and cannot simply be concatenated.

研究先解决数据及规则问题，再训练专用评审模型。SFT学习完整参考答案；RL根据模: We first address data and rules, then train specialized reviewers. SFT learns complete reference answers. RL scores the student's own outputs to improve recall. OPD tests whether detailed rules can be learned into weights to shorten inference input. CoT tests whether teacher rationales help verdicts. The model providing answers or guidance is the teacher; the trained model is the student.

Data construction and rule revision form the common base. Artifact review and DSH extend the reviewed objects and label-production methods.

本研究的主要结果是确定了几项可继续采用的设计：对齐精确输入版本、保留完整业务规则: The experiments establish several designs worth retaining: exact input-version alignment, full business rules, valid and multi-issue samples, and a verdict-only baseline for rationale training. Evidence is organized by task, method, setup, and comparison, with conditions that affect interpretation made explicit.

2026年7〜10月、Spec-RJM では過去データと業務ルールを整備し、教師あり微調整（SFT）、強化学習（RL）、確率蒸留（OPD）、理由の監督（CoT）を比較した。後半は元の要求ごとに分離した学習7,127単位・テスト792単位を使用。詳細なルールは有用で、複数問題の RL は4組中3組でエラーモード F1 を改善し、教師の明示的理由を比較した3条件では判定のみの学習が優れた。
本研究构建设计与产物两类规则评审模型。Spec-RJM 根据 Query + S: This study develops rubric judges for both designs and artifacts. Spec-RJM checks requirement coverage, product capabilities, and design consistency from Query + Spec. Artifact-RJM checks actual configuration, object references, and requirement fulfillment from Query + final-artifact Markdown. Between July and October 2026, the design track compared SFT, RL, OPD, and rationale supervision; the artifact track independently built five-domain data and completed an SFT run and fixed-snapshot evaluation.

本研究では設計と成果物の2種類のルール評価モデルを構築する。Spec-RJM は Query + Spec から要求の網羅性、製品機能、設計の整合性を評価する。Artifact-RJM は Query + 最終成果物の Markdown から実際の設定、オブジェクト参照、要求の実現を評価する。2026年7〜10月、設計側では SFT・RL・OPD・理由監督を比較し、成果物側では独立した5領域データを作成して SFT と固定スナップショット評価を実施した。
两类评审都以用户需求为准。Spec Judge 检查方案是否说清楚、能否实现；产: Both judges use the user request as the standard. The Spec Judge checks whether the design is explicit and feasible. The artifact Judge must find created objects and actual configuration, checking field types, references, filter scopes, and action dependencies. The stronger acceptance requirement is implementation evidence: writing “notify the owner” in a design cannot substitute for a configured recipient, and static configuration alone does not prove delivery.
どちらもユーザーの要求を基準とする。Spec Judge は設計が明確で実現可能かを確認し、成果物 Judge は作成済みのオブジェクトと実設定を探し、フィールド型、参照、絞り込み範囲、アクションの依存関係を確認する。検収で追加されるのは実装の証拠だ。設計に「担当者へ通知」と書かれていても受信者設定の代わりにはならず、静的設定だけでは通知の到達も証明できない。
Artifact-RJM 每次只评一个域。System Prompt 提供该域的: Artifact-RJM reviews one domain per call. The system prompt supplies that domain’s product capabilities, input semantics, rubric cards, and output protocol. The user message contains only domain, original query, and the current domain’s artifact_markdown. The Spec remains an input to Code Agent, not an extra requirement for artifact review, so a model-expanded design cannot silently become a user obligation.

Artifact-RJM は1回の呼び出しで1領域を評価する。System Prompt は当該領域の製品機能、入力の解釈、ルールカード、出力形式を定める。User Message は domain、元の query、当該領域の artifact_markdown のみ。Spec は Code Agent の生成入力に置き、成果物審査の追加要求にはしない。モデルが補った設計をユーザーの必須要求に変えてしまうことを防ぐ。
五域分别是 Table、Dashboard、Workflow、Permissio: The five domains are Table, Dashboard, Workflow, Permission, and View. Formula, Lookup, and Link belong to Table; table views and Forms belong to View. Each reported issue must meet the rule’s prerequisites, violation conditions, and evidence requirements. One minimal failure fact is assigned to its most specific rule, while independent issues on different objects remain separate. One response contains Category → Rubric → Mode, fixed severity, reasons, and a domain verdict.

5領域は Table・Dashboard・Workflow・Permission・View。Formula・Lookup・Link は Table、テーブルビューと Form は View に含める。各問題はルールの前提、違反条件、必要な証拠を満たす必要がある。同一の最小の違反事実には最も具体的なルールを1つ割り当て、異なる対象の独立した問題は別々に残す。1回の応答で Category → Rubric → Mode、固定の重大度、理由、領域判定を出力する。
训练样本按“一条 Query × 一个产物域”组织。969 个 Case 按原始: Training examples are organized as one Query × one artifact domain. The 969 cases are grouped by original Query: 872 for training and 97 for internal testing, giving 4,360 / 485 review units. Luna medium produces single-review reference labels under the full rules; Seed2 Lite receives two epochs of LoRA SFT with the same rule and input structure. Cases govern splitting and aggregation; domain review units are the training examples.

学習例は「1つの Query × 1つの成果物領域」で構成する。969 Case を元の Query でグループ分割し、872 Case を学習、97 Case を内部テストに用いる。評価単位はそれぞれ4,360 / 485。Luna medium が完全なルールで1回ずつ参照ラベルを生成し、同じルールと入力構造で Seed2 Lite を2エポック LoRA SFT する。Case は分割・集約の単位であり、学習単位は領域ごとの評価例となる。
Artifact-RJM 与既有 E2E Judge 在同一份产物上对照。前者输: Artifact-RJM and the existing E2E Judge are compared on the same artifacts. The former produces fine-grained labels for five domains, with any failing domain making the case fail; the latter uses its own domain reviews and a global Mix adjudicator. Sharing an artifact does not imply identical rules or decision procedures. The 97 cases replay fixed Markdown snapshots: these comparisons measure judgments, not the success rate of newly rebuilt artifacts.
Artifact-RJM と既存の E2E Judge を同じ成果物で比較する。前者は5領域の細粒度ラベルを出力し、1領域でも fail なら Case を fail と集約する。後者は独自の領域審査と Mix による全体判定を行う。対象が同じでもルールや判定手順は同一ではない。97 Case は固定 Markdown の再評価であり、新たに構築した成果物の成功率ではない。
一个真实测试例说明了这个边界：用户要求先建主表、再填子表，并录入一道完整试题。产: One recorded test case makes the boundary concrete. The user asked for parent tables first, child records next, and one complete exam question as an example. The artifact had no Workflow. Luna returned pass for that domain, while the student reported missing_automation, interpreting a one-time construction order as an ongoing automation requirement. This motivates paired examples of “automation required” versus “complete the build,” alongside checks for genuine trigger, reference, and write defects.

実際のテスト例では、親テーブルを先に作り、子レコードを入力して、試験問題を1件完成例として登録するよう要求されていた。成果物に Workflow はなく、Luna はこの領域を pass としたが、学生は missing_automation を報告した。一度限りの構築手順を継続的な自動化要求と誤読した例だ。「自動化が必要」と「構築を完了すればよい」の対になる例を補い、実際のトリガー・参照・書き込みの欠陥も検査する必要がある。
